ops.title: Upstream cc-transcript: per-arg raw/span exposure on Command args
ops.description: cc-transcript (13.x and the 14.0 Rust engine alike) exposes only dequoted parsed args — no per-argument raw spelling or byte span. captain-hook's rm guard therefore carries a `plain_words` whole-command provenance proxy (quote-free raw => every arg verbatim) and forfeits rewrites whenever quoting or backslash-newline continuations appear. Upstreaming per-arg `raw`/`span` onto `Command.args` (or a parallel `Command.words`) deletes the proxy and unlocks exact token re-emission everywhere (16 reconstruction sites counted in the 2026-07-18 inventory). Precedent: the command layer itself migrated upstream in captain-hook commit 1ed2be90.
